name: bpplus-js-reservoir
description: Pulse wave, reservoir-excess pressure and wave intensity analysis of Uscom BP+ measurements: a JavaScript port of BPplus-Reservoir (bpp_Res2 beta7).
//: There is no build step and there are no runtime dependencies.
Most consumers copy reservoir/ into their own tree and pin it by tag, as they
do the BP+ SDK, rather than install it.
version must stay in step with RESERVOIR_JS_VERSION in reservoir/index.js;
